from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the collection: its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers cited by this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated records for the document batch."""
    papers: list[Paper]
